items.title: Courtland Sutton: Four yards on eight targets
items.text:
Sutton caught one of eight targets for four yards in Friday's 27-5 loss to the Steelers.

items.title: Bo Nix: Awful showing in Friday's loss
items.text:
Nix completed 22 of 40 passes for 169 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions in Friday's 27-5 loss to the Steelers. He also rushed once for seven yards and lost a fumble.

items.title: Jonah Coleman: Eight catches in lopsided loss
items.text:
Coleman rushed 15 times for 26 yards and caught eight of 10 targets for 46 yards in Friday's 27-5 loss to the Steelers.

items.title: Mac Jones: Getting spot start in Week 12
items.text:
Head coach Kyle Shanahan announced that Jones will start in place of Brock Purdy (ankle) on Sunday against the Seahawks.
